data.sections.core: Core unit functions such as HP and death animation
data.sections.core.name: Defines the unit raw name, game uses it to identify as a unique name. (This is not displayed in-game)
data.sections.core.mass: The 'weight' of the unit, defines how it collides with other units, a greater value means it's tougher to push.
data.sections.core.radius: Circular area around the unit that makes it selectable. (mouse click/screen touch)
data.sections.core.price: The unit cost from builders/buildings. Defaults to credits if no resource type is used
data.sections.core.maxHp: The max health for the unit. (will spawn with this value).
data.sections.core.buildSpeed: Time it takes to build the unit. (may multiply with builder speed)
data.sections.core.class: Reserved for future use, must be CustomUnitMetadata by default. Is not necessary to include, has no additional functions.
data.sections.core.techLevel: Defines the Tech Level of the unit, there're 3 levels and each will appear in a different color in the GUI.
data.sections.core.altNames: Comma separated list of names. Like name but lower priority, useful for multiple optional mods.
data.sections.core.strictLevel: Defaults to 0. 1 = Errors if keys are duplicated. Add to "all-units.template" in root to apply to all units.
data.sections.core.isBio: Choose whether the unit is bioligical or not, affects sound and splat (unless hideScorchMark:true)
data.sections.core.isBug: Changes some death defaults, and sort order in Sandbox.
data.sections.core.isBuilder: Normally required if this unit places buildings. Defaults to [ai]useAsBuilder.
data.sections.core.streamingCost: Like price but paid for overtime while this unit is being queued or built. Construction or queue is paused if resources run out while building.
data.sections.core.switchPriceWithStream: Shortcut to set streamingCost to price value and clear price, add to all-units.template to quickly switch a mod over to streaming resources.
data.sections.core.maxShield: The max shield hitpoints of the unit. Can start with 0 hitpoints if startShieldAtZero:true.
data.sections.core.startShieldAtZero: Unit starts with a 0 hitpoints shield on created if true.
data.sections.core.energyMax: Defaults to 0. Energy that can be used as ammo for turrets, laser defense and actions.
data.sections.core.energyStartingPercent: Sets the percentage of charged energy when the unit is first built.
data.sections.core.energyNeedsToRecharge: Disables weapons using energy after reaching zero till fully recharged if true.
data.sections.core.armour: Damage taken away from each hit. (not currently used in any vanilla units)
data.sections.core.armourMinDamageToKeep: Min damage to keep from received damage. Defaults to 1.
data.sections.core.borrowResourcesWhileA: Takes these resources when created and returns them when removed or destroyed.
data.sections.core.borrowResourcesWhileB: Like borrowResourcesWhileAlive but doesn't take affect till built. Mostly useful for buildings like houses that have negative resources to add to the unit cap, etc.
data.sections.core.generation_delay: How often generation_resources/credits is added. Defaults to 40. (changing not recommended)
data.sections.core.showInEditor: Set to false to hide unit in Sandbox editor. (Defaults to true)
data.sections.core.displayText: The unit name that the game shows to the player.
data.sections.core.displayText_es: LANG = ISO 639-1 Code to show this text instead when game is in this language.
data.sections.core.displayDescription: Unit description that the game shows to the player.
data.sections.core.displayDescription_es: LANG = ISO 639-1 Code to show this text instead when game is in this language.
data.sections.core.displayLocaleKey: Translation file key for unit name and description.
data.sections.core.displayRadius: Defaults to radius value. Set to show a larger or smaller selection circle UI on units.
data.sections.core.uiTargetRadius: Defaults to displayRadius value. Radius used when attacking/reclaiming/etc this unit
data.sections.core.shieldRenderRadius: Defaults is a little bigger than radius. Set to show a larger or smaller shield circle on units.
data.sections.core.shieldDisplayOnlyDefl: Hide shield unless deflecting shot if true.
data.sections.core.shieldDeflectionDispl: Defaults to 4. High value causes shield deflection to fade disappear faster.
data.sections.core.showOnMinimap: Defaults to true. Hide units on minimap if false.
data.sections.core.showActionsWithMixedS: Shows a merged action list if all units selected includes one of these tags. Useful for converted units.
data.sections.core.isBuilding: Defines if the unit is a building.
data.sections.core.footprint: Left, up, right, down. Tiles taken up which block unit movement. Defaults to 0,0,0,0  = 1 center tile.
data.sections.core.constructionFootprint: Tiles taken up for placement of other buildings. Defaults to 0,0,0,0 = 1 center tile.
data.sections.core.displayFootprint: Left, up, right, down. Only applies to buildings, just used for GUI. Defaults to footprint.
data.sections.core.buildingSelectionOffs: Defaults to 0. Adds or removes padding on the drawn selection rect in UI.
data.sections.core.buildingToFootprintOf: Defaults to 10. Change the building position in the footprint on the X-axis.
Defaults to 10. Change the building position in the footprint on the Y-axis.
data.sections.core.placeOnlyOnResPool: Normally used for extractors, forces building construction in a resource pool.
data.sections.core.selfBuildRate: Rate unit builds itself when placed without a builder.
data.sections.core.ignoreInUnitCapCalcul: defaults to true for buildings otherwise false. Set to true to not count this unit in unit cap.
data.sections.core.copyFrom: Uses unit data from another ini file as default for this unit, supports multiple files.
data.sections.core.dont_load: Do not load unit, and don't error on missing data. Can be useful when used with copyFrom.
data.sections.core.overrideAndReplace: Overrides another unit with this unit. Build links and map positions to target unit will be replaced.
data.sections.core.onNewMapSpawn: Values: emptyResourcePools_asNeutral, emptyOrOccupiedResourcePools_asNeutral, mapCenter_asNeutral, mapCenter_eachActiveTeam, spawnPoint_eachActiveTeam (1.15)
data.sections.core.isLocked: Disallow building of this unit. Can be used with overrideAndReplace to restrict units player can build.
data.sections.core.isLockedIfGameModeNoN: Disallows building of this unit if nukes are disabled during match setup.
data.sections.core.experimental: Tag unit as experimental. Affects zoomed out icon and end game stats.
data.sections.core.stayNeutral: Set to false to disable capture when unit is on the neutral team.
data.sections.core.createNeutral: Set to true to always spawn the unit on the neutral team.
data.sections.core.createOnAggressiveTea: Set to true to always spawn the unit on aggressive teams on single player matches.
data.sections.core.tags: List of comma separated strings. Used to classify units, create special actions and balances.
data.sections.core.defineUnitMemory: Can define several variables for custom storage, unique for each unit. Allowed types: boolean, float/number, unit, string.
data.sections.core.fogOfWarSightRange: Sets number of tiles this unit can see through the fog of war. Defaults to 15.
data.sections.core.fogOfWarSightRangeWhi: Fog of War range when unit/building is incomplete. Defaults to fogOfWarSightRange
data.sections.core.softCollisionOnAll: Creates a soft collision effect when touching other units.
data.sections.core.disableAllUnitCollisi: Unit cannot collide with others if true.
data.sections.core.isUnrepairableUnit: No unit can repair this unit if true.
data.sections.core.isUnselectable: If true unit cannot be selected. (includes AI players)
data.sections.core.isUnselectableAsTarge: Defaults to isUnselectable. Can be used to create units that cannot be selected but can be targeted for attack, reclaim, etc
data.sections.core.isPickableStartingUni: If true, unit is added to dropdowns for starting unit in game setup menus.
data.sections.core.startFallingWhenStart: Unit will appear falling from skies when starting unit if true.
data.sections.core.soundOnAttackOrder: List of sound names. Only one will be played on each attack order. Only .ogg and .wav formats.
data.sections.core.soundOnMoveOrder: List of sound names. Only one will be played on each move order. Only .ogg and .wav formats.
data.sections.core.soundOnNewSelection: List of sound names. Only one will be played on each unit selection. Only .ogg and .wav formats.
data.sections.core.canNotBeDirectlyAttac: No unit can directly target this unit. If true this will also skip this unit in victory/defeat checks. If true, canNotBeDamaged is true by default
data.sections.core.canNotBeDamaged: Defaults to value of canNotBeDirectlyAttacked (be careful setting this without canNotBeDirectlyAttacked, as AI will attack forever)
data.sections.core.canNotBeGivenOrdersBy: If true unit will not take player or AI orders.
data.sections.core.canOnlyBeAttackedByUn: List of tag strings, only units with these tags can directly target this unit.
data.sections.core.disableDeathOnZeroHp: Setting to true allows unit to continue living even at 0 HP, useful for custom "death" action. Warning: If not used with an autoTrigger, etc units will attack this unit forever.
data.sections.core.allowCaptureWhenNeutr: When true, it lets to be captured on contact by AI as well. Defaults as false
data.sections.core.transportSlotsNeeded: Defaults to 1. Number of slots this unit uses up in a transport, experimentals are often set to 5.
data.sections.core.maxTransportingUnits: Number of slots this units has for transporting other units.
data.sections.core.transportUnitsRequire: Only allows trasport of units that have one of these tags.
Only allows trasport of units that have one of these movement types.
data.sections.core.transportUnitsBlockAi: Defaults to true. This unit can only transport LAND units if true.
data.sections.core.transportUnitsEachUni: Defaults to false. Units in this transport occupy 1 slot always if true, ignoring transportSlotsNeeded.
data.sections.core.transportUnitsKeepBui: Makes built units stay inside transport instead of exiting it once ready if true.
data.sections.core.transportUnitsCanUnlo: Defaults to: if not self.isOverLiquid() and not self.isMoving(). This unit cannot unload units if false.
data.sections.core.transportUnitsAddUnlo: Defines if unload button should be added to the unit menu
data.sections.core.transportUnitsUnloadD: Changes the delay it takes between each unit getting unloaded.
data.sections.core.transportUnitsKillOnD: Defaults to true. If false transported units don't die when transport dies.
data.sections.core.transportUnitsHealBy: Rate to heal units that are being transported.
data.sections.core.transportUnitsBlockOt: Defaults to true, if false this transports can hold other transports.
data.sections.core.whileNeutralTransport: This unit can transport units of any team while neutral if true.
data.sections.core.whileNeutralConvertTo: Converts this unit to transported team while neutral. Useful with whileNeutralTransportAnyTeam.
data.sections.core.convertToNeutralIfNot: Reverts back this unit to neutral when unloaded. Useful with whileNeutralTransportAnyTeam.
data.sections.core.transportUnitsOnTeamC: Keeps transported units on their orginal team when this unit is converted if true.
data.sections.core.resourceRate: Used with canReclaimResources. Allows other teams to reclaim this unit. Normally used with neutral team. Use price to set what resources are gained.
data.sections.core.similarResourcesHaveT: When this has been reclaimed harvester unit moves on to another resource with these tags.
data.sections.core.resourceMaxConcurrent: Defaults to unlimited. Set to restict how many units can reclaim this resource at the same time.
data.sections.core.reclaimPrice: Like price but for resources. Useful for buildable resources.
data.sections.core.canReclaimResources: If true this unit can gather resources, useful with resourceRate.
data.sections.core.canReclaimResourcesNe: Defines the resource search range of this unit when its main gathered resource runs out.
data.sections.core.canReclaimResourcesOn: This unit is only allowed to gather resources with these tags.
data.sections.core.canReclaimUnitsOnlyWi: This is for reclaiming units, not for resources. See canReclaimResourcesOnlyWithTags
data.sections.core.resourceReclaimMultip: Multiplies the builder's reclaim speed. Different from the related key "nanoUnbuildSpeed"
data.sections.core.canRepairUnitsOnlyWit: Repairs units with the specified tags
data.sections.core.canRepairBuildings: Can this can heal ally buildings (isBuilder:true is required)
data.sections.core.canRepairUnits: Can this can heal ally units. (isBuilder:true is required), canRepairBuildings required for buildings.
data.sections.core.autoRepair: Automatically try and repair damaged units in nano range. (isBuilder:true is required)
data.sections.core.nanoRange: Defaults to 85. Defines the unit building/repair/reclaim range.
data.sections.core.nanoRepairSpeed: Defaults to 0.2. Defines the unit nano repair/reclaim speed.
data.sections.core.nanoBuildSpeed: Defaults to 1. Defines the unit nano building speed. (May multiply with target's buildSpeed)
data.sections.core.nanoUnbuildSpeed: How fast a builder reclaims an incomplete building (defaults to 1)
data.sections.core.nanoReclaimSpeed: How fast a builder reclaims a normal unit (not a resource unit)
data.sections.core.nanoRangeForRepairIsM: Defines if this unit must touch its target to repair it.
data.sections.core.nanoRangeForReclaimIs: Defines if this unit must touch its target to reclaim it.
data.sections.core.nanoRangeForRepair: Defines a specific range for the repair action of this unit.
data.sections.core.nanoRangeForReclaim: Defines a specific range for the reclaim action of this unit.
data.sections.core.nanoFactorySpeed: Defaults to 1. Multiplies the buildSpeed value of the created unit if this unit is a factory.
data.sections.core.extraBuildRangeWhenBu: Temporarily adds extra build range to builders to build this unit. Useful for water based buildings.
data.sections.core.builtFrom_{NUM}_name: Useful if adding this unit to build to existing buildings. Like canBuild but in opposite direction.
data.sections.core.builtFrom_{NUM}_pos: Order this build link appears in UI. Using canBuild instead is more recommended.
data.sections.core.builtFrom_{NUM}_force: Build as if this is a building if true. (even if it's a unit)
data.sections.core.builtFrom_{NUM}_isLoc: If true this unit cannot be built in this build link. (can be conditioned if logicBooleans are used)
Message shown when this build link is locked.
data.sections.core.exit_x: Where created or unloaded units appears from the transport or building. Defaults to 0.
data.sections.core.exit_y: Where created or unloaded units appears from the transport or building. Defaults to 5.
data.sections.core.exit_dirOffset: Defaults to 180 for units and 0 for buildings. Defines the exit direction of created or unloaded units.
data.sections.core.exit_heightOffset: Defaults to 0. Defines the height where created or unloaded units appears.
data.sections.core.exit_moveAwayAmount: Defaults to 70. Defines the distance that created or unloaded units moves from this unit.
data.sections.core.exitHeightIgnoreParen: Ignores parent height for exit height; useful for separating attachments with their parents for building
data.sections.core.dieOnConstruct: Deletes this unit when it starts to build if true. (target building/unit likely will need selfBuildRate set)
data.sections.core.dieOnZeroEnergy: Kills this unit if energy level reaches zero when true.
data.sections.core.numBitsOnDeath: Defines the number of scattered bit fragments when this unit dies.
data.sections.core.nukeOnDeath: Unit will spawn a nuke detonation built-in effect when dies if true.
data.sections.core.nukeOnDeathRange: Defines the nuke effect range when using nukeOnDeath.
data.sections.core.nukeOnDeathDamage: Defines the nuke effect area damage when using nukeOnDeath.
data.sections.core.nukeOnDeathDisableWhe: Defaults to false. If true this unit will not explode with nuke when nukes are disabled in skirmish maps.
data.sections.core.fireTurretXAtSelfOnDe: Auto-shoot a specific turret when this unit dies.
data.sections.core.explodeOnDeath: Defaults to true. Disables the unit death explode built-in effect if false.
data.sections.core.explodeOnDeathGroundC: Defaults to true. Disables the explode built-in effect on death when unit touches ground if false.
data.sections.core.explodeTypeOnDeath: options: verysmall, small, normal, large, largeUnit, building, buildingNoShockwaveOrSmoke
data.sections.core.effectOnDeath: Spawns built-in or custom effects when unit dies.
data.sections.core.effectOnDeathGroundCo: Like effectOnDeath but when unit touches ground. Useful for flying units.
data.sections.core.unitsSpawnedOnDeath: Spawns these units when dies. Comma separated unit identifiers.
data.sections.core.unitsSpawnedOnDeath_s: Units spawned on death will appear on the last attacker team if true.
data.sections.core.hideScorchMark: Disables the death scorch mark leaved when unit dies if true.
data.sections.core.soundOnDeath: Sets a custom sound for this unit death.
data.sections.core.effectOnDeathIfUnbuil: If the unit was not completed, and is destroyed, play this effect. Defaults to effectOnDeath
data.sections.core.autoTriggerCooldownTi: Post automatic action cooldown (Not detection cooldown). Defaults to 1s. Warning: Setting this too low for many units might effect performance depending on the action effects.
Allows for auto action cooldown lower than 0.2s. Default to false. Not recommended.
data.sections.core.autoTriggerCheckRate: options: everyFrame (default), every4Frames, every8Frames. Note: all triggers regardless of check rate are checked when first created and after an auto trigger cooldown. Note: Adding [core]autoTriggerCheckRate:every8Frames to all-units.template could have a large performance boost for mods with complex autoTriggers.
data.sections.core.autoTriggerCheckWhile: Defaults to false. autoTrigger of unit actions check even when not completely built if true
data.sections.core.updateUnitMemory: Faster memory update than [action_#] setUnitMemory. Useful on many applications.
data.sections.core.updateUnitMemoryRate: Sets how often the memory is updated. Defaults at 1s. settings it to 0 will update memory every frame.
data.sections.core.@memory: A template-friendly method of defineUnitMemory. Declare name followed by type, separated by a colon
data.sections.graphics: Main image configuration and unit trails
data.sections.turret: Turret that follows attack permissions and uses projectile
data.sections.projectile: Can be used by turret and can spawn more projectiles
data.sections.ai: How AI may use this unit, mostly for buildings
data.sections.leg: Moveable cosmetics for mechs, infantry etc.
data.sections.arm: Moveable cosmetics for mechs, infantry etc.
data.sections.attachment: Units stacked onto original to make compound units
data.sections.action: Actions that can do very wide range of things
data.sections.hiddenAction: Actions that can do very wide range of things
data.sections.effect: Visual effects spawned by unit that eventually disappear
data.sections.animation: Animations for leg, arm or main body sprite
data.sections.placementRule: Allows creation of rules for buildings
data.sections.global_resource: Global resource collected by team shows up on top
data.sections.resource: Local resource used by units can be used for ammo
data.sections.decal: Versatile graphics can be stack to make 2.5D sprites
data.sections.comment: Used exclusively for notes, does not read anything
data.sections.template: Used to create sections that can be referenced in unit
